validation: finite X-Timestamp within 0..604800 seconds and metadata duration when known
allowed MIME and bounded native decoder

lifecycle.foreground: resume; ready presentation and auxiliary/prepared caches retained
lifecycle.unchanged_settings: immutable relevant-value snapshot; no row generation or cache reset
lifecycle.diagnostics_toggle: updates backend logging without configuration revision/invalidation
lifecycle.explicit_clear_cache: cancels leases, clears backend/memory/disk caches and rebinds rows
lifecycle.background: pause image tickets; retain bounded leases and immutable snapshots
lifecycle.memory_warning: release decoded auxiliary/prepared caches; retain guarded row presentations and leases

prefetch.after_exhaustion: cached-only polling every 60 seconds while current lease remains valid; no new speculative generation

frame_disk_cache.data: validated compressed response bytes, MIME and returned timestamp
frame_disk_cache.queue: serial utility file I/O; asynchronous shared-pool admission
frame_disk_cache.read_path: same timestamp validation, MIME decoder and row-generation guards as HTTP
frame_disk_cache.clear_epoch: queued reads cancelled on explicit clear

diagnostics: report cached_random_http, next_attempt_seconds, exhausted, cache_only, cache_invalidation_reason
limitations: Cached random fallback can use the service latest frame rather than a badge-derived exact frame
